about: The tillr backend policy for a machine whose only provider is Amazon Bedrock (the work profile). Same shape and same rules as backend-policy.json beside it, which is the personal machines' policy; a drain on a Bedrock machine names this file with --policy. The build, review and scout seats run the profile's workhorse row and the design seat runs the frontier row, both through the pi adapter. Two files is the stopgap docs/design/tillr-convergence.md OQ-TC2 records: the target is that tillr names only seats and the machine's profile resolves them, at which point this file is deleted.
